lines.text: پس اگر معدل النهار بر سمت الرأس آنموضع گذرد انرا افق استوائیه و منتصبه و مستقیمه گویند
lines.en: Then if the celestial equator passes through the zenith of that place, they call it the equatorial, erect, and direct horizon.

lines.text: و اگر قطب معدل النهار سمت الرأس آنموضع باشد انرا افق رحوي گويند و عظيمه که بدو قطب
lines.en: And if the pole of the celestial equator is the zenith of that place, they call it the mill-like horizon. And the great circle that [passes] through the two poles

lines.text: افق و دو قطب معدل النهار گذرد انرا دایره نصف النهار گویند از جهة انتصاف
lines.en: of the horizon and the two poles of the celestial equator, they call it the meridian circle, because of the halving

lines.text: نهار حین وصول آفتاب باین دایره فوق الافق در اکثر ربع مسکون و عظیمه که بدو قطب
lines.en: of the day when the sun reaches this circle above the horizon in most of the inhabited quarter. And the great circle that [passes] through the two poles

lines.text: افق و مرکز کوکب گذرد انرا دایره ارتفاع الکوکب گویند و صغیره که از نقطه تقاطع کوکب
lines.en: of the horizon and the center of a star, they call it the circle of altitude of the star. And the small circle that from the point of intersection of the star

lines.text: مرتسم بشود بحرکت فلک کلی انرا مدار يومي الکوکب گویند و این با معدل النهار لا محاله
lines.en: is drawn by the motion of the universal sphere, they call it the daily parallel of the star. And this is inevitably [parallel] to the celestial equator

lines.text: یا متوازي باشد یا متحد پس اگر اینمدار دایره افق را قطع کند انچه از ان فوق الافق بود
lines.en: or identical. Then if this parallel intersects the horizon circle, whatever of it is above the horizon

lines.text: قوس النهار الکوکب گویند و انچه تحت الافق بود قوس اللیل و انچه میان طرف خط تقویمي
lines.en: they call the arc of the day of the star, and whatever is below the horizon, the arc of the night. And whatever is between the end of the ecliptic line

lines.text: کوکب و افق شرقي باشد از قوس النهار افق غربي از فوق اللیل انرا دایره الکوکب گویند
lines.en: of the star and the eastern horizon from the arc of the day [and] the western horizon from above the night, they call it the circle of the star.

lines.text: اما شبانه روز نزد عامه مجموع یکشب و یک روز است و مبداء ان نزد متشرعه اول شب است
lines.en: As for the day and night (nycthemeron), according to the common people it is the sum of one night and one day, and its beginning according to the religious scholars is the beginning of the night,

lines.text: چه ظلمت اصل است و نور طاري و نزد اهل نجوم و فارس اول راست در جه نور وجودي
lines.en: because darkness is the original state and light is adventitious. And according to the astronomers and Persians, the beginning is right in the degree of existential light

lines.text: و ظلمت عدمي اما نزد حساب از رسیدن ثوابت بتقاطع مدار او با دایره نصف النهار
lines.en: and privative darkness. But according to the calculators, from the arrival of the fixed stars at the intersection of its parallel with the meridian circle

lines.text: چه باین اصطلاح در جمیع مقدار شبانه روزي متساوي بود تقریبا بخلاف اصطلاحات
lines.en: because by this convention in all the amount of the nycthemeron it would be equal approximately, contrary to the conventions

lines.text: دیگر بحسب مرتفعه متفاوست چنانکه بر عالم علم هیأت مخفي نیست و معبر نزد حکماي
lines.en: other according to the altitude it is different, as is not hidden to the one learned in the science of astronomy. And the interpreter according to the philosophers

lines.text: یونان تقاطع اعالیست و نزد حکماي خطا و ایغور تقاطع اسفل اما مبداء روز در عرف
lines.en: of Greece is the upper intersection, and according to the philosophers of Cathay and Uyghur the lower intersection. But the beginning of the day in the custom

lines.text: اهل شرع از مبداء طلوع صبح صادق است و مبداء شب بعد از استيفاي غروب آفتاب
lines.en: of the people of religious law is from the beginning of the rising of the true dawn, and the beginning of the night is after the completion of the setting of the sun.

lines.text: و نزد اهل روم و فارس مبداء روز از طلوع آفتابست و مبداء شب از غروب جرم
lines.en: And according to the people of Rome and Persia, the beginning of the day is from the rising of the sun, and the beginning of the night is from the setting of the body

lines.text: او و انموضع طبيعي است چه وجود نهار مشروط بطلوع شمس است و جود لیل مشروط بنبودن
lines.en: of it. And that place is natural, because the existence of the day is conditional on the rising of the sun, and the existence of the night is conditional on the non-being

lines.text: او و ذکر شب و روز و اجزاي آن که مصنف در ضمن ابواب خواهد کرد بر این اصطلاحست
lines.en: of it. And the mention of night and day and its parts that the author will make within the chapters is based on this convention.

sections.text:
اکثر
و سواکب و افق آفاقي موازيه معدل النهار عمودا لا يري ابدا و بعضي يرون امور کثيره
sections.en:
Most
and stars and the horizon of horizons parallel to the celestial equator perpendicularly are never seen, and some see many things.

summary.headline: Horizons, Stellar Circles, and Day-Night Conventions
summary.text: Definitions of horizon types, the meridian circle, stellar altitude circles and daily parallels, including the arcs of a star’s day and night. The nycthemeron and conventions for beginning day and night are compared among religious scholars, astronomers, Persians, calculators, Greek philosophers, Cathay and Uyghur philosophers, and Romans.
